channel.title: Daily Thanthi Group - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Daily Thanthi Group (dtnext.in)

item.title: K'taka Cong holds protests against MGNREGA name change, 'hate politics' in National Herald case
item.description: Speaking to reporters here, Large and Medium industries Minister M B Patil alleged that the BJP could not fathom the success of the programme and so they have changed the name now.

item.title: EAM Jaishankar holds talks with Israel PM Netanyahu on deepening bilateral ties
item.description: Jaishankar arrived in Israel on Tuesday on a two-day visit during which he called on President Isaac Herzog and held discussions with his Israeli counterpart Gideon Sa'ar and Minister of Economy and Industry Nir Barkat.

item.title: AI Summit in New Delhi platform for Global South to shape international AI agenda: India
item.description: UN Secretary General Antonio Guterres will attend the India–AI Impact Summit 2026 that will be held on February 19-20 in New Delhi.

item.title: Significant steps in 'people-centric' India-Ethiopia partnership: Modi highlights outcomes of visit
item.description: Modi arrived in Ethiopia on Tuesday on his maiden bilateral visit, during which the two countries elevated their historical ties to the level of 'Strategic Partnership'.

item.title: FIFA slashes price of some World Cup tickets to USD 60 after global fan backlash
item.description: Despite the outcry over prices, FIFA says it has already received more than 20 million ticket requests in its latest sales phase.

item.title: INST researchers develop new nanoparticle-based multifunctional therapy for Alzheimer’s
item.description: Conventional Alzheimer’s therapies often target only a single pathological feature, such as amyloid aggregation or oxidative stress, yielding limited clinical benefit.

item.title: Investigators release additional video of possible Brown gunman as search continues
item.description: Two clips taken minutes after the shooting show the person walking away from a parking lot and then along a street.

item.title: Rashmika Mandanna makes the most of her short 'girl's trip' to Sri Lanka
item.description: This trip comes amidst rumours that Rashmika will be tying the knot with her 'Dear Comrade' co-star Vijay Deverakonda next year, hinting that her Sri Lankan vacation might actually be a Bachelorette trip.

item.title: Railway Board clears signalling system for Poonamallee–Porur Metro corridor
item.description: The Poonamallee–Porur Junction stretch, spanning about 10 km, is set to become the first corridor of Phase II to be opened to the public.

item.title: Nightclub fire: Luthra brothers brought to Goa from Delhi
item.description: A team of the Goa Police, along with the Luthra brothers, landed at the Manohar International Airport, Mopa, in North Goa at 10.45 am.
